_note: One definition per riding area. Every tool reads this; nothing hardcodes a bbox. Adding a region is one entry here, then `python3 tools/pipeline.py --region <id>`. `state` is the outline drawn at low zoom for orientation only — never routable.

neml-bullgap.name: Bull Gap · Mio · Rose City
neml-bullgap.note: Huron NF east of M-33 plus the Ogemaw state trails.

sthelen.name: St. Helen · Roscommon
sthelen.note: St. Helen scramble area and the Au Sable State Forest trails. Different DNR management unit from the Bull Gap region, which is the point of having it — it proves the pipeline is not shaped around one place. Roscommon (2.5 km west) and Houghton Lake (16.2 km west) were listed as anchors but fall outside this bbox; a chip for them panned the rider off the map. Removed at take 96 rather than widening the bbox, which would change what this region downloads — that is a judgement call, not a bug fix.

michigan.name: Michigan
michigan.note: The whole state, both peninsulas and Isle Royale — Jacob's call at take 114: 'the one-stop Michigan app'. bulk:true means the pipeline reads the Geofabrik extract directly (a statewide Overpass query would abuse a volunteer service), skips contours and z12+ imagery tiles (measured impossible at take 75: 8.6 GB), and raises landcover thresholds so the ground wash carries shape, not slivers. Centre sits in Mio/Luzerne trail country, not the geographic middle: the state's legal network is archipelagos, and the default spawn must stand on an island, not in the farmland between them (take 117).
